title: Vesicor Therapeutics and Black Hawk Acquisition Corporation Announce Closing of Business Combination
Vesicor Therapeutics completes SPAC merger, set for Nasdaq listing
Black Hawk Acquisition Corporation has Changed its Name to Vesicor Therapeutics Holdings, Inc
Vesicor Therapeutics, Inc. completed the acquisition of Black Hawk Acquisition Corporation from a group of shareholders in a reverse merger transaction.
Black Hawk Acquisition Corporation Announces Redemption Results in Connection With Its Business Combination With Vesicor Therapeutics Inc.
